turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just started drums. My teacher wants me to learn a basic rock beat. What's the pattern?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Count one, two, three, four. Hi hat on every count, kick drum on one and three, snare on two and four.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My wife's just had knee surgery and she's itching to get back on the trails.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good for her. The old railway path is completely flat but a bit dull, while the marsh boardwalk is prettier with a few steps. Which would she rather start with?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Zip it for a sec, Moshi, I'll tell you when I'm back. Daniel needs me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Does this smell like it's burning to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little, yeah. How long has it been in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Only twenty minutes. The recipe says forty.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Our oven runs hot though. Remember the pizza?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, right. Should I cover it with foil?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, and turn it down a bit. The middle probably still needs time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you come back early today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm done over here. You can jump in now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Back to your wife's comeback walk. Railway path or marsh boardwalk?
